verdict.rationale: Runloop's Snapshots feature explicitly saves disk state of a Devbox and allows creating new Devboxes from that saved state, directly supporting pause/resume of filesystem state. However, the docs describe snapshot-to-new-devbox restoration rather than an explicit in-place pause/resume of the same running sandbox, and there's no explicit mention of memory/process state (only disk state) being preserved. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that in-memory/process state (not just disk) is preserved, and independent/hands-on corroboration of pause-resume workflow.
